answer: Make each reward reachable only through a shared basin: an address can withdraw just the flow that arrived via counterparty edges it did not itself create. Clone rings trade among themselves, so their inflow drops down one enclosed inlet and drained value returns to the same few keys; honest agents sit at the nadir of many independent streams feeding their balance. Audit net external inflow ratio per address, and where every edge folds back inside a single cluster, prune the whole vine. Faking it then demands real outside flow.
